items.t: Goldman Sachs Cut Its Broadcom Target to $460, and the Reason Has Nothing to Do With Broadcom’s Earnings
items.sum: Key Takeaways Goldman Sachs cut its Broadcom price target to $460 from $540 on Nov. 18 and kept its Buy rating, so the target was still 30% above that day’s close.

items.t: Goldman Sees Inflation Cooling by the end of 2027
items.sum: Goldman Sachs expects inflation to cool to 2.4% by the end of 2027 as tariff, energy and AI-related pressures fade. But Goldman's Chief US Economist David Mericle says the Fed may still raise rates in December and March, waiting for clearer evidence that inflation is easing.

items.t: Goldman Sachs: Why I'm Waiting For $750
items.sum: Analyst rates Goldman Sachs a Hold: shares exceed $840 normalized fair value, and a meaningful margin of safety would require $750 or lower.
